subject.facility_name: SHADY KNOLL CENTER FOR HEALTH & REHABILITATION

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $183.0 per resident day (42.1% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -7.8% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $131,686, 1.7% of the $7,572,822 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,303,163, $31.49 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $631,264 (48.4%), allocated fringe $187,101 (14.4%), non-wage costs $484,798 (37.2%). Raw food was $408,378 ($9.87 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $32,495.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $530,104, $12.81 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $368,635 (69.5%), allocated fringe $109,260 (20.6%), non-wage costs $52,209 (9.8%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $353,929, $8.55 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $191,905 (54.2%), allocated fringe $56,879 (16.1%), non-wage costs $105,145 (29.7%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
